files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: book_reservation
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new reservation for the specified user, itinerary (one-way or round-trip), cabin, passengers, baggage counts, insurance choice, and payment methods, and returns the newly created reservation record including its reservation ID. It refuses requests that are missing required fields, use invalid enum values (flight_type, cabin, insurance), provide malformed flight dates, or include passengers/payment methods that don’t include the required sub-fields. It also refuses bookings when the user_id does not exist, when the listed flight segment(s) cannot be found for the given flight_number/date, or when the requested inventory/state cannot be booked (for example, no availability for the requested cabin or an inconsistent itinerary such as origin/destination not matching the provided flight segments).

date.description: The date for the flight in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2024-05-01'.
date.title: Date

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format
dob.title: Dob

user_id.description: The ID of the user to book the reservation such as 'sara_doe_496'`.
user_id.title: User Id

origin.description: The IATA code for the origin city such as 'SFO'.
origin.title: Origin

destination.description: The IATA code for the destination city such as 'JFK'.
destination.title: Destination

flight_type.description: The type of flight such as 'one_way' or 'round_trip'.
flight_type.title: Flight Type

cabin.description: The cabin class such as 'basic_economy', 'economy', or 'business'.
cabin.title: Cabin

flights.description: An array of objects containing details about each piece of flight.
flights.title: Flights

passengers.description: An array of objects containing details about each passenger.
passengers.title: Passengers

payment_methods.title: Payment Methods

total_baggages.description: The total number of baggage items to book the reservation.
total_baggages.title: Total Baggages

nonfree_baggages.description: The number of non-free baggage items to book the reservation.
nonfree_baggages.title: Nonfree Baggages

tool_schemas.name: calculate
tool_schemas.description: Evaluates the provided arithmetic expression and returns the computed numeric result. It refuses expressions that contain characters or operators outside the supported set (+, -, *, /, parentheses, numbers, and spaces) or that are not syntactically valid (for example, unbalanced parentheses). It also refuses expressions that cannot be evaluated reliably, such as division by zero or operations that overflow/produce non-finite results.

expression.description: The mathematical expression to calculate, such as '2 + 2'. The expression can contain numbers, operators (+, -, *, /), parentheses, and spaces.
expression.title: Expression

tool_schemas.name: cancel_reservation
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an existing reservation and returns the updated reservation state reflecting the cancellation. It refuses requests with a missing or unknown reservation_id. It also refuses cancellation when the reservation is not in a cancelable state (for example, already canceled or otherwise finalized) or when the reservation cannot be modified due to ownership/authorization constraints.

tool_schemas.name: get_reservation_details
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the full details for a single reservation identified by reservation_id. It refuses requests with a missing or unknown reservation_id. It also refuses access when the caller is not allowed to view that reservation (for example, the reservation does not belong to the specified/active user context).

tool_schemas.name: get_user_details
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns a user profile for the given user_id, including the user’s associated reservations. It refuses requests with a missing or unknown user_id. It also refuses access when the caller is not permitted to view that user’s profile/reservations due to ownership/authorization constraints.

tool_schemas.name: list_all_airports
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current list of airports known to the service (typically including their IATA codes and related metadata). It refuses requests that include unexpected parameters or malformed input for this endpoint. It may also refuse the request when the airport catalog is temporarily unavailable.

_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0286000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0286000") else "/app/database")

    import json, os
    data = {'flights': json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, 'flights.json'), encoding='utf-8')), 'users': json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, 'users.json'), encoding='utf-8')), 'reservations': json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, 'reservations.json'), encoding='utf-8'))}
    airports = [
        "SFO",
        "JFK",
        "LAX",
        "ORD",
        "DFW",
        "DEN",
        "SEA",
        "ATL",
        "MIA",
        "BOS",
        "PHX",
        "IAH",
        "LAS",
        "MCO",
        "EWR",
        "CLT",
        "MSP",
        "DTW",
        "PHL",
        "LGA",
    ]
    cities = [
        "San Francisco",
        "New York",
        "Los Angeles",
        "Chicago",
        "Dallas",
        "Denver",
        "Seattle",
        "Atlanta",
        "Miami",

    return json.dumps({airport: city for airport, city in zip(airports, cities)})

tool_schemas.name: search_direct_flight
tool_schemas.description: Searches for non-stop flights matching the given origin, destination, and date, and returns the list of matching flight options with schedule/availability details. It refuses requests with missing fields, malformed dates (not YYYY-MM-DD), or invalid airport codes. It also refuses searches where origin and destination are the same or when no route/schedule data exists for the requested pair/date.

origin.description: The origin city airport in three letters, such as 'JFK'.
origin.title: Origin

destination.description: The destination city airport in three letters, such as 'LAX'.
destination.title: Destination

date.description: The date of the flight in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2024-01-01'.
date.title: Date

tool_schemas.name: search_onestop_flight
tool_schemas.description: Searches for one-stop itineraries from origin to destination on the given date and returns matching options including the connection segments. It refuses requests with missing fields, malformed dates (not YYYY-MM-DD), or invalid airport codes. It also refuses searches where a valid single-connection itinerary cannot be constructed from the available schedule data (for example, no compatible connections for that date).

origin.description: The origin city airport in three letters, such as 'JFK'.
origin.title: Origin

destination.description: The destination city airport in three letters, such as 'LAX'.
destination.title: Destination

date.description: The date of the flight in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2024-05-01'.
date.title: Date

tool_schemas.name: send_certificate
tool_schemas.description: Issues and sends a credit/certificate for the specified user and amount, and returns confirmation of the issued certificate. It refuses requests with a missing/unknown user_id, a missing amount, or a non-positive/invalid amount. It also refuses issuance when the service policy or user state does not allow certificates to be sent (for example, blocked accounts or disallowed certificate conditions).

user_id.description: The ID of the user to book the reservation, such as 'sara_doe_496'.
user_id.title: User Id

amount.description: The amount of the certificate to send.
amount.title: Amount

tool_schemas.name: transfer_to_human_agents
tool_schemas.description: Escalates the conversation to a human agent and returns confirmation that the handoff was initiated, including the provided issue summary. It refuses requests that omit the summary or provide an empty/meaningless summary. It also refuses transfers when escalation is not permitted for the current session/context (for example, no active user conversation to hand off or escalation is disabled).

summary.description: A summary of the user's issue.
summary.title: Summary

tool_schemas.name: update_reservation_baggages
tool_schemas.description: Updates the baggage counts on an existing reservation (total bags and non-free bags) and returns the updated reservation details. The request is refused if the reservation_id does not match an existing reservation, if total_baggages or nonfree_baggages are invalid (for example negative values or nonfree_baggages greater than total_baggages), or if payment_id is missing/unknown. It is also refused when the reservation is not in a state that allows baggage changes or the supplied payment method cannot be used for any additional non-free baggage charges.

total_baggages.description: The updated total number of baggage items included in the reservation.
total_baggages.title: Total Baggages

nonfree_baggages.description: The updated number of non-free baggage items included in the reservation.
nonfree_baggages.title: Nonfree Baggages

payment_id.description: The payment id stored in user profile, such as 'credit_card_7815826', 'gift_card_7815826', 'certificate_7815826'.
payment_id.title: Payment Id

tool_schemas.name: update_reservation_flights
tool_schemas.description: Replaces the flight itinerary and cabin for an existing reservation using the full flights array provided, and returns the updated reservation details reflecting the new segments and cabin. The request is refused if reservation_id is unknown, if cabin is not one of the supported values, if flights is empty or contains segments missing flight_number or date, or if the flight segments cannot be booked (for example not found, not operating on that date, or no inventory for the requested cabin). It is also refused when the reservation is not eligible for flight changes, when the new itinerary conflicts with the reservation’s passenger/baggage constraints, or when payment_id is missing/unknown or cannot cover any fare difference.

date.description: The date for the flight in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2024-05-01'.
date.title: Date

cabin.description: The cabin class of the reservation
cabin.title: Cabin

flights.description: An array of objects containing details about each piece of flight in the ENTIRE new reservation. Even if the a flight segment is not changed, it should still be included in the array.
flights.title: Flights

payment_id.description: The payment id stored in user profile, such as 'credit_card_7815826', 'gift_card_7815826', 'certificate_7815826'.
payment_id.title: Payment Id

tool_schemas.name: update_reservation_passengers
tool_schemas.description: Updates the passenger list on an existing reservation and returns the updated reservation details with the revised passenger information. The request is refused if reservation_id is unknown, if passengers is empty, or if any passenger entry is missing first_name, last_name, or dob, or contains an invalid date format. It is also refused when the reservation is not in a state that allows passenger changes or when the updated passenger list conflicts with the current reservation (for example exceeding what the itinerary can support).

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format
dob.title: Dob

passengers.description: An array of objects containing details about each passenger.
passengers.title: Passengers

tool_schemas.name: get_flight_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the operational status for the specified flight_number on the given date. The request is refused if flight_number or date is missing, if date is not in the expected format, or if the flight cannot be found for that date. It may also be refused when the service does not have status data available for the requested flight/date combination.

metadata.name: AeroLedger Reservations Hub
metadata.description: A backend service for managing traveler profiles, browsing airports and flight availability, booking and modifying reservations (passengers, flights, baggage), checking flight status, handling cancellations, and escalating cases to human agents.
